### {{< fa dog >}}

I grew up in Wisconsin—Go Pack Go! I like to read, listen to podcasts, and puzzle (can you [puzzle faster](https://myspeedpuzzling.com/en/player-profile/0193cd4b-faa8-7252-aff3-96fdfc47cf9c) than me?). I recently took a beginner crochet class and am hooked! My favorite TV show is Survivor.

My partner Matt and I enjoy playing cribbage and listening to live music, as well as walking our Giant Schnauzer, Blu—short for Blugold, a nod to where we met at UW–Eau Claire.
